text: No fire was detected on the asset (ASSET-F01) during the evaluated period (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-23). NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data from VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS sensors showed zero detections intersecting the asset boundary. All sensors had full coverage of the period. However, small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected. The assessment does not confirm the absence of burned areas or the cause of any potential changes.
